decisions.reason: As an upgraded and rebranded version of an already well-liked trommel screen, A appears to have resolved positively with low portfolio risk and should be kept.

B looks embedded in the established AK series and the 2019 Stage V update signals continued commitment, so its option value has largely turned into a viable core offer rather than a candidate for exit.
C survived the first portfolio shakeout and gained its own page in 2019, suggesting enough remaining upside to justify keeping it, though it still seems somewhat less proven than the stronger lines.
F shows the strongest evidence of positive resolution, with explicit claims of segment leadership and concrete reference use, so management would very likely retain it.
